name: xmlstarlet
description: Command-line XML toolkit: select (XPath/XSLT), edit, validate, transform

xmlstarlet.description: Command-line XML toolkit: XPath select, edit, validate, XSLT transform
xmlstarlet.usage:
xmlstarlet sel -t -v '//book/@id' file.xml # XPath select attribute values
xmlstarlet sel -t -m '//item' -v 'title' -n file.xml # Iterate matches, print field
xmlstarlet ed -L -u '//config/@version' -v '2.0' file.xml # In-place edit attribute
xmlstarlet ed -L -d '//deprecated' file.xml # Delete nodes
xmlstarlet ed -L -i '//root' -t elem -n 'newchild' -v 'value' file.xml # Insert element
xmlstarlet val -e file.xml # Validate well-formedness with errors
xmlstarlet val -s schema.xsd file.xml # Validate against XSD schema
xmlstarlet tr stylesheet.xsl file.xml # Apply XSLT transform
xmlstarlet fo file.xml # Format/pretty-print
xmlstarlet c14n file.xml # Canonicalize XML
xmlstarlet escape 'value with <special> chars' # Escape XML entities
xmlstarlet pyx file.xml # Convert to PYX (line-oriented)
